prompt_for_image_ai: Create a 512 by 512 flat vector landing sticker for the Social RIASEC type. Keep the current sticker composition exactly: upright rounded-square border frame, large capital S on the left, small circular S badge at bottom-right. Keep the large S treatment with its bold dark outline and current sticker-style separation. Fill the full canvas and the entire inside of the frame with KursoKo landing paper color #FDFCF8 — no transparency, no black fill, no cloud backdrop. Use only one character, not two. Replace the character with KursoKo questionnaire art style: unDraw-inspired student illustration, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D on the character, flat color fills, minimal dot eyes, natural dark hair, simplified hands. Use a young Guardian student with medium brown skin and dark hair in a low puff bun. Body faces slightly inward-left toward the large letter. Left hand opens outward in a welcoming helping gesture toward the letter. Right arm tucks a slim clipboard close to the side, with the clipboard front facing slightly left. Use the Social results color #9575CD clearly in the cardigan or vest accents: lavender cardigan over a light top, dark skirt or trousers, dark shoes. Keep props minimal — the clipboard is the hero prop, and at most one tiny speech-bubble or heart icon if needed. No second person, no crowded scene, no white cutout around the character.
